sources.scope: Official ICML metadata plus final publisher PDF selected sections 3, 4.1, 4.6-4.9 (printed pp.5-9); 2025 arXiv v1 settings kept as version-specific history. Official repository tree and selected inference interfaces inspected statically.
sources.finding: Final section 4.7 explicitly uses reward, value and action logits for PPO; section 4.6 contrasts progress pretraining. Unified modeling is prior art. sources.title: Studying the Interplay Between the Actor and Critic Representations in Reinforcement Learning
sources.scope: official metadata/abstract; arXiv 2503.06343v1 selected representation/evaluation sections; N2 sections 5-6 and pinned shared/separate Procgen PPO entrypoints
sources.finding: Generic actor/critic specialization is existing knowledge. Batch diversity and critic-mediated data collection are competing explanations, not only direct representation gradients. Separate networks differ from our same-network value-only detach.

sources.finding: Interference and useful feature sharing are established; phasic learning is a strong alternative.
